description: This file defines functions and types related to handling subagent attachments, including base64 decoding, attachment limits, and materialization of attachments with filesystem operations.

methods.name: decodeStrictBase64
methods.description: Decodes a base64 string strictly, returning a Buffer or null if invalid or exceeding max size.

methods.name: resolveAttachmentLimits
methods.description: Resolves attachment limits from the provided configuration.

methods.name: materializeSubagentAttachments
methods.description: Materializes attachments by writing them to the filesystem, respecting size and count limits, and returning a result object.
